findings: Observed-tree feature and builder selection (`aws-lc-rs 1.18.1` features=`[aws-lc-sys, prebuilt-nasm]`, `aws-lc-sys 0.45.0` features=`[prebuilt-nasm]`, `cc 1.7.0` features=`[parallel]`): `aws-lc-rs` disables `aws-lc-sys` default features (`all-bindings` is off) and leaves `fips`, `bindgen`, `ssl`, `asan`, and `disable-prebuilt-nasm` unselected. In `aws-lc-sys/builder/main.rs::initialize()`, for target `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` under a clean environment without `AWS_LC_SYS_*` overrides, `!is_all_bindings() && !is_fips_crate()` emits `cargo:rustc-cfg=universal` (or `universal_no_u1` if `CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS` selects Cranelift) and sets `PREGENERATED = true`, making `is_bindgen_required() == false` so neither internal `bindgen` nor external `bindgen-cli` is invoked. In `get_builder()`, if `system_detect` returns `None`, execution skips `CmakeBuilder` and selects `CcBuilder` with `OutputLibType::Static` and symbol prefix `Some("aws_lc_0_45_0")`. `aws-lc-rs/build.rs` selects `aws-lc-sys` and re-exports `DEP_AWS_LC_0_45_0_*` links metadata after verifying `DEP_AWS_LC_0_45_0_INCLUDE` is present.

`system_detect.rs` auto-detection, external `pkg-config` edge, and fallback: Unless `AWS_LC_SYS_SYSTEM_DIR` is set or `AWS_LC_SYS_USE_SYSTEM` (or target-suffixed `AWS_LC_SYS_USE_SYSTEM_x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu`) is explicitly falsy (`0`/`no`/`off`/`false`), `get_builder()` calls `system_detect::detect_system_awslc()`. It first checks `OPENSSL_DIR` and `OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR`/`OPENSSL_LIB_DIR` (target-suffixed first, then bare, emitting `cargo:rerun-if-env-changed`). When those env vars are unset (as in the proposed strict env), `detect_candidate_layouts()` falls back on Unix (`#[cfg(unix)]`) to `pkg_config_candidates()`, invoking `pkg_config::Config::new().cargo_metadata(false).probe(module)` for `"openssl"`, `"aws-lc"`, `"libcrypto"`, and `"libcrypto-awslc"`. This spawns the external `pkg-config` binary if present and tracks `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` env metadata. Any candidate is validated via `SystemLib::probe()` (requiring `OPENSSL_IS_AWSLC` header markers and pregenerated system bindings). If `pkg-config` is absent, fails, or finds only non-AWS-LC OpenSSL or an invalid layout, `detect_system_awslc` prints a non-fatal diagnostic and returns `None`, falling back to `CcBuilder` source compilation (only failing if `AWS_LC_SYS_USE_SYSTEM=1`). Setting `AWS_LC_SYS_USE_SYSTEM=0` bypasses `system_detect` and `pkg-config` entirely.

`cc_builder.rs` environment handling and compiler/assembler probes: `CcBuilder` reads `TARGET`, `HOST`, `OPT_LEVEL`, `OUT_DIR`, `CARGO_CFG_TARGET_*`, `LDFLAGS` (in `memcmp_check`), and compiler/flag overrides via `get_crate_cc()`, `get_crate_cxx()`, and `get_crate_cflags()` (`AWS_LC_SYS_HOST_CC`/`HOST_CC`/`TARGET_CC`, `AWS_LC_SYS_CC`/`CC`, `AWS_LC_SYS_HOST_CXX`/`HOST_CXX`/`TARGET_CXX`, `AWS_LC_SYS_CXX`/`CXX`, `AWS_LC_SYS_HOST_CFLAGS`/`HOST_CFLAGS`/`TARGET_CFLAGS`, `AWS_LC_SYS_CFLAGS`/`CFLAGS`, plus `_x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu` variants), mutating `CC_<target>`, `CXX_<target>`, and `CFLAGS_<target>` in the build-script process if set. It invokes the C toolchain (`cc::Build`, backed by `cc 1.7.0` with `parallel`) to run `try_compile_intermediates()` probes into temporary `<OUT_DIR>/out-<basename>` directories (deleted after each check) against source files under `<manifest_dir>/aws-lc/tests/compiler_features_tests/`: `c11.c` (selecting `-std=c11` or `-std=c99`), `stdalign_check.c` (`-DAWS_LC_STDALIGN_AVAILABLE=1`), `builtin_swap_check.c` (`-DAWS_LC_BUILTIN_SWAP_SUPPORTED=1`), and on Linux `linux_random_h.c` (`-DHAVE_LINUX_RANDOM_H=1`, retrying with `-DDEFINE_U32` for `-DAWS_LC_URANDOM_NEEDS_U32=1`). For `OPT_LEVEL` outside `"0"|"1"|"2"`, it probes `is_flag_supported` for `-ffile-prefix-map=<manifest_dir>=` (or `-fdebug-prefix-map=<manifest_dir>=`) and, for GNU compilers on Linux, `-Wa,--debug-prefix-map=<manifest_dir>=` (with `CFLAGS*` temporarily cleared via `EnvGuard`).

`cc_builder.rs` host-executed GCC `memcmp_check` probe: When `!is_cross_compiling()` (`HOST == TARGET`, true on native `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`) and the resolved compiler `is_like_gnu()`, `CcBuilder::memcmp_check()` directly executes `<compiler> -dumpfullversion` (and `-dumpversion` if needed). Only if the reported GCC version is in `9.0`..`9.3`, `10.0`..`10.1`, major-only `9`/`10`, or unparseable does it invoke `<compiler>` to compile and link `<manifest_dir>/aws-lc/tests/compiler_features_tests/memcmp_invalid_stripped_check.c` into `<OUT_DIR>/memcmp_invalid_stripped_check` (appending `LDFLAGS` if set) and then directly execute `<OUT_DIR>/memcmp_invalid_stripped_check` on the host before unlinking it. On GCC >= 10.2 (e.g., GCC 11+) or Clang (`!is_like_gnu()`), the compile-and-run step is skipped after the version/family check; if the probe fails to compile or fails to spawn (e.g., `noexec` `<OUT_DIR>`), it emits a warning and continues, panicking only if the probe binary executes and exits non-zero.

`cc_builder.rs` native compilation units, flags, and generated outputs on `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`: `identify_sources()` concatenates `universal::CRYPTO_LIBRARY` and `linux_x86_64::CRYPTO_LIBRARY`. `add_all_files()` partitions `<manifest_dir>/aws-lc/<source>` into three `cc::Build` invocations (plus `NasmBuilder`): (1) `s2n_bignum_builder` compiles `third_party/s2n-bignum/**` intermediates with `--include=<manifest_dir>/generated-include/openssl/boringssl_prefix_symbols_asm.h` and `-DS2N_BN_HIDE_SYMBOLS=1`; (2) unless `AWS_LC_SYS_NO_JITTER_ENTROPY=1`, `jitter_entropy_builder` compiles `third_party/jitterentropy/**` intermediates with `-DAWSLC=1`, `-fPIC`, `--include=<manifest_dir>/generated-include/openssl/boringssl_prefix_symbols.h`, path-reproducibility flags (including a `-fsanitize-undefined-strip-path-components=-1` probe), GNU dialect flags (`-fwrapv --param ssp-buffer-size=4 -fvisibility=hidden -Wcast-align -Wmissing-field-initializers -Wshadow -Wswitch-enum -Wextra -Wall -pedantic -O0 -fwrapv -Wconversion`), and `EnvGuard` overrides forcing `-O0 -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE` across all `CFLAGS*` variants; (3) the main `cc_build` compiles remaining `.c`/`.S` files with `-Wno-unused-parameter`, `-pthread`, `-D_XOPEN_SOURCE=700`, `-DBORINGSSL_IMPLEMENTATION=1`, `-DBORINGSSL_PREFIX=aws_lc_0_45_0`, `-Wa,--noexecstack`, and 5–7 include directories under `<manifest_dir>`, links all intermediate objects, and archives `<OUT_DIR>/libaws_lc_0_45_0_crypto.a` via `cc_build.compile("aws_lc_0_45_0_crypto")`. Post-build `setup_include_paths()` creates `<OUT_DIR>/include` and copies headers from `<manifest_dir>/include`, `<manifest_dir>/generated-include`, and `<manifest_dir>/aws-lc/include` into `<OUT_DIR>/include`, emitting `cargo:root`, `cargo:include`, `cargo:libdir`, `cargo:libcrypto_path`, `cargo:libcrypto`, `cargo:link_kind`, `cargo:system_libs`, and `cargo:conf`.

`nasm_builder.rs` behavior and Linux `prebuilt-nasm` no-op/hazard: `NasmBuilder::compile_intermediates()` returns `vec![]` immediately without invoking `"nasm"` or accessing `builder/prebuilt-nasm/*.obj` whenever `self.files.is_empty()` (no `.asm` files in `identify_sources()`). In `builder/main.rs::use_prebuilt_nasm()`, the `prebuilt-nasm` fallback is hard-gated on `target_os() == "windows" && target_arch() == "x86_64"`, and `NasmBuilder` only emits `-f win64`/`win32` `.obj` outputs. Thus, on `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, the crate feature `prebuilt-nasm` has no effect (`use_prebuilt_nasm()` is `false`); as long as `universal::CRYPTO_LIBRARY` and `linux_x86_64::CRYPTO_LIBRARY` contain only `.c`/`.S` files (and no `.asm` files), `NasmBuilder` is a complete no-op, whereas any `.asm` entry on Linux would execute `"nasm" "-version"` and panic if `nasm` is missing.

`fips_probe.rs` source effects and non-reachability under observed features: `fips_probe::verify_fips_install()`, `compile_fips_probe()`, and `run_fips_probe()` are only invoked by `system_library.rs` when probing a system-installed AWS-LC while `is_fips_build()` is true (`aws-lc-fips-sys` or `feature = "fips"`). Under observed `aws-lc-rs=[aws-lc-sys, prebuilt-nasm]` and `aws-lc-sys=[prebuilt-nasm]`, `is_fips_build()` is `false`, so `fips_probe` (and `builder/main.rs::link_fips_runtime_check`) is never called. When reached in a FIPS + system-library build, `fips_probe` requires `<manifest_dir>/builder/fips_link_probe.c`, invokes the C compiler (`clang`/`gcc`/`msvc`) without LTO flags to link `<OUT_DIR>/aws_lc_fips_link_probe` against the system `libcrypto` (with `-pthread -ldl -lm` and `-Wl,-rpath,<lib_dir>` on Linux), and executes the probe binary on the host (or via `CARGO_TARGET_<TRIPLE>_RUNNER` when cross-compiling).

agreedRequiredFields.summary: Narrow source inspection of `aws-lc-rs 1.18.1` (`features=[aws-lc-sys, prebuilt-nasm]`) and `aws-lc-sys 0.45.0` (`features=[prebuilt-nasm]`) across `build.rs`, `builder/main.rs`, `cc_builder.rs`, `system_detect.rs`, `nasm_builder.rs`, and `fips_probe.rs` for target `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` under a strict clean environment. Under these exact tree features (`all-bindings`, `bindgen`, `fips`, `ssl`, and `asan` disabled), `aws-lc-sys` selects pregenerated `universal` Rust bindings (`is_bindgen_required() == false`), probes for a system AWS-LC via `system_detect` (`OPENSSL_*` env vars then `pkg-config` on Unix unless `AWS_LC_SYS_USE_SYSTEM=0`), and falls back on probe rejection/absence to `CcBuilder` static source compilation (`libaws_lc_0_45_0_crypto.a`) while `fips_probe` remains unreachable (`is_fips_build() == false`) and `nasm_builder` is a no-op provided `universal::CRYPTO_LIBRARY` and `linux_x86_64::CRYPTO_LIBRARY` contain no Windows `.asm` sources (`use_prebuilt_nasm()` is gated on `target_os() == "windows"`). Exact external tool edges (`pkg-config`, C/ASM compiler and archiver via `cc`, `gcc -dumpfullversion`/`-dumpversion`, and the conditional GCC 9.0–9.3/10.0–10.1 host-executed `memcmp_invalid_stripped_check` binary) and finite unprovided source paths (`builder/cc_builder/*.rs` submodules and `<manifest_dir>/{aws-lc,include,generated-include,src}/**`) are enumerated below.
